toolchain.note: HOME forced to /home/runner so unremapped cargo/sysroot paths converge

notes: Verified bit-for-bit vs the published v30.0.1 ethrex-linux-x86_64. Reproduces once you replicate the CI env: Ubuntu 22.04 + rustc 1.93.0 + HOME=/home/runner (the release bakes unremapped /home/runner/.cargo paths; there is no --remap-path-prefix). The v30.0.1 tag and v30.0.1-rc.3 tag are the same commit, so the rc-rename does not matter. The l2 feature is off for this binary (no solc/SP1/RISC0).
